estateResourceId.description: Public identifier minted by the digital estate hosting the supplier intake (e.g. baobab-platform/thamani, baobab-platform/zuribeans); never a database primary key.

canonicalOrganisationId.description: Optional reference to the ADR-BCP-018 canonical Organisation (CanonicalEntity id). Runtime authority is Control Plane. Null until linked; producers must not invent Organisation ids outside Control Plane admission/registration.

applicationStatus.description: The proven lifecycle from baobab-platform/zuribeans ADR-0006, reused as the canonical wire-level status set. A hosting estate whose process genuinely differs may propose extending this enum via a versioned contract change; it must not invent parallel status strings out of band.
